name: Dorik AI
summary: AI website builder that's easy to maintain without code.
description: Dorik generates a business site or blog from a description, then lets you edit it with drag and drop. Hosting, CMS and forms are included, and a white-label plan targets agencies.

features: AI-generated websites that are easy to maintain.
